nodes.name: check_input
nodes.prompt:
You are a conversation analyser extracting key information points from a conversation between a human and an assistant. The conversation below is about a workshop creation and you are looking for the following data points: role, duration, workshop_type, purpose, audience_size.

Reply according to the output format instructions below, trying to fill in as many fields as possible.

If one or more data points are missing, generate a question asking for them. Ask for no more than 2 data points in a single question.

If the conversation is missing, assume all key points are missing.

Conversation:
{conversation}

Output format instructions:
{format_instructions}

role.description: The role of the workshop creator/facilitator in the organisation.

workshop_type.description: The type of the workshop - in-person, online, etc.

audience_size.description: The size of the audience of the workshop.

question.description: A question asking the workshop creator to provide a missing key variable.

complete.description: True when all five data points are present.

nodes.name: analyse_last_message
extract
nodes.prompt:
You are a conversation analyser. Below you are provided with a conversation between a human and an assistant about a workshop design, formatted like:
```
human:
message content
assistant:
message content
...
```
One of the messages contains a workshop design. Find it and return the contents of the message without any additional information or alterations.

Never explain your reasoning or provide any additional information outside of the workshop design.

Conversation:
{conversation}

Output format instructions:
{format_instructions}

current.description: The current iteration of the workshop design found in the conversation.

nodes.name: retrieve_refine
nodes.query_template: I need information about Liberating Structures suitable for a {workshop_type} for {audience_size} people held by {role} for {duration} in order to {purpose}.

nodes.name: refine
nodes.prompt:
You are a renowned expert in Liberating Structures.

You are provided with a workshop design based on Liberating Structures and a human request to alter it.

Based on the context provided below, apply the changes the user requested to the current workshop design.

Never explain your reasoning or provide any additional information outside of the workshop design.

The design format is Markdown. Preserve the formatting, indentation and structure of the design. Add nice indentation to the design and do not remove any empty lines.

Workshop design:
{current}

Human request:
{current_question}

Context:
{knowledge_docs}

nodes.name: retrieve_generate
nodes.query_template: I need information about Liberating Structures suitable for a {workshop_type} for {audience_size} people held by {role} for {duration} in order to {purpose}.

nodes.name: generate
nodes.prompt:
Here is information about Liberating Structures that are suitable for the scenario described below. Base your answer ONLY on that and ignore your previous knowledge about Liberating Structures.

Liberating Structures information:

{knowledge_docs}

Design a workshop for a {workshop_type} for {audience_size} people, held by a {role}, for {duration}, in order to {purpose}, using only the Liberating Structures information provided above.

Never explain your reasoning or provide any additional information outside of the workshop design. The design format is Markdown.
